title: feat: add StepFun Step 5 Preview via OpenRouter with Vercel fallback
author: tomdacatto

gist.summary: Added paid-only `stepfun/step-5-preview` with no aliases or Pollinations GPU route. It accepts text and image input, returns text, and supports tool calling, structured outputs, streaming, and reasoning controls; video input is excluded. StepFun documents a 1M-token context and 64K-token output limit. OpenRouter’s StepFun fp8 endpoint is the primary route, with a hidden Vercel AI Gateway route as fallback; the fallback supports tool calls and tool history. Input, cached-input, and output prices are billed per 1M tokens, with separate rates for the two routes. No retirement date or successor has been confirmed for the preview.
